name: DrownedWillowArch
collider: trunk + big limbs + roots solid (capsules / simplified mesh of Bark and BarkMossy objects); Plants (strand curtains, moss drips) no collider
notes: Pivot = trunk base centre at the bottom of the roots (roots go 0.40 m under the water line). Objects: Bark, BarkMossy (trunk/limb upper sides, root tops), Moss (drape on upward faces), Plants (willow_strands_0/1 hang cards in layered curtain shells + a few moss_drip cards). Wind UV2: bark sway up to ~0.04 m, strands sway from the hang point (= branch sway) growing to the tips + flutter 0.05 m.
